name: Transfer Conversations from an Agent with an Omni
description: When an agent encounters conversations that it can’t resolve, it uses the Escalation topic to escalate the conversation. In the new Agentforce Builder (beta), you can also run the Escalation topic using the escalate utility function in Agent Script. Escalation and transferring works differently depending on the agent type and channel. You can customize the experience that customers receive when transferring isn’t possible.
